annotations.title: Caesar cipher, ROT13: shift letters by any amount

description: Encode or decode text with a Caesar cipher: every letter A-Z shifted by 1-25 places (13, the default, is ROT13), case kept, digits and punctuation untouched. decode=true shifts back. Use for puzzles, spoiler hiding and teaching; it is not encryption. Example: text=Hello, World!. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
